title: Multi-agent LLMs on the Cloud-Edge-IoT Continuum: A Systematic Mapping Study on Architectures, Deployment, and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM applications are increasingly built as systems of cooperating components rather than as single prompt-response pipelines. IoT applications add constraints of their own, because sensing, reasoning, control, and actuation are spread across devices, edge nodes, and cloud services to meet latency, privacy, and bandwidth requirements. How multi-agent LLM systems are organized and deployed across this cloud-edge-IoT continuum has not been mapped systematically. We therefore conducted a systematic mapping study. From 831 records retrieved up to March 2026, we selected 45 primary studies and classified each one by architecture family, deployment pattern, application domain, and evaluation practice. We also recorded how each system was evaluated and whether its code or data are public. Five architecture families recur in the corpus. Specialized agent teams run next to sensors, planners delegate subtasks to workers, and small local models coop

translated_title: 云-边-物联网连续体上的多智能体大语言模型：关于架构、部署与评估的系统性映射研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）应用正越来越多地被构建为由协作组件组成的系统，而非单一的提示-响应流水线。物联网应用还带来了自身的约束，因为感知、推理、控制和执行分布在设备、边缘节点和云服务上，以满足延迟、隐私和带宽方面的要求。多智能体LLM系统如何在这一云-边-物联网连续体上进行组织和部署，此前尚未得到系统性梳理。因此，我们开展了一项系统性映射研究。从截至2026年3月检索到的831条记录中，我们筛选出45项主要研究，并按架构家族、部署模式、应用领域和评估实践对每项研究进行分类。我们还记录了每个系统的评估方式，以及其代码或数据是否公开。语料库中反复出现五个架构家族：专门的智能体团队部署在传感器旁运行，规划者将子任务委派给执行者，小型本地模型相互协作……
tldr: 本文通过一项系统性映射研究，首次对多智能体大语言模型系统在云-边-物联网连续体上的架构、部署模式、应用领域与评估实践进行了系统分类与梳理，为该新兴交叉领域绘制了研究全景图。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic mapping study that classifies 45 primary studies on multi-agent LLM systems across the cloud-edge-IoT continuum by architecture family, deployment pattern, application domain, and evaluation practice, providing the first structured overview of this emerging field.
